events.seoTitle: Scott Pilgrim vs. the World Screening in Hackney | Beloved Film Club
events.seoDescription: Watch Scott Pilgrim vs. the World at Beloved Film Club in Hackney, London, on 24 November 2026. A cosy film night at Moylett's. Book tickets.
description: Edgar Wright's 2010 comedy stars Michael Cera as Scott Pilgrim, a young bassist who has to defeat the seven evil exes of Mary Elizabeth Winstead's Ramona Flowers before he can date her. It's iconic, funny and just simply charming.

Beloved Film Club is our regular film night in a relaxed pub setting, celebrating great cinema. Come on your own or bring a friend: everyone is welcome. The film starts at 7:00 PM, and we recommend arriving earlier to grab a drink or something to eat before getting comfortable. Popcorn on us 🍿
